description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the AIConfiguration class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It handles reading configuration data from a file or custom defaults, parsing JSON arrays, and providing accessors for various configuration parameters related to AI and system settings.

classes.name: AIConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for managing AI-related system configuration, reading from a config file or default values, and providing accessors for various configuration parameters.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the configuration by reading from the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads configuration parameters from the specified ini file, parsing key-value pairs and updating member variables accordingly.

methods.name: readFromCustomData
methods.description: Populates configuration parameters with default custom data values.

methods.name: printAIConfiguration
methods.description: Outputs current configuration values for verification and debugging.
